description: Expected cause of each difference above 5% between the feature build and the recorded bridged build (Requirement 37.10), keyed scenario/metric. Taken from design D.6's comparison table; the report flags any >5% difference without a note here. Revise each note once the full run confirms or contradicts it.

notes.small-get/app_cpu_us_per_op: Expected near or below the bridge once the H11-style pipeline cache applies (racecar measured about 67 µs). The remaining gap to smithy-java is the HTTP client (37 of 67 µs) and signing (D.6).
notes.describe-table/app_cpu_us_per_op: The bridge skips the V2 framework; the schema deserializer should be comparable (D.6).
notes.batch-get/app_cpu_us_per_op: Expected below the bridge: the bridge converts SdkPojo to smithy-java shapes and back, while the schema path deserializes straight into the POJOs (D.6).
notes.batch-put/app_cpu_us_per_op: Same as batch-get, plus racecar E1 request-buffer sizing (D.6).
notes.small-get/alloc_bytes_per_op: Expected below the bridge, which allocates adapter objects. smithy-java's lower number reflects its own HTTP client (D.6).
notes.batch-get/alloc_bytes_per_op: Expected below the bridge, whose conversion copies every item (D.6).
notes.batch-put/alloc_bytes_per_op: Expected below the bridge: no conversion copies, and E1 buffer sizing is kept (D.6).
